caption: The drawing depicts two rectangular textile samples placed one above the other, each with distinct patterns and color schemes. The upper textile sample features a red background adorned with evenly spaced circular floral motifs in white, with internal black and red detailing, and small diamond-shaped black elements scattered between the floral motifs. The lower textile sample also has a red background, but its design consists of large, stylized floral or abstract elements in black outlined and filled with yellow, set at the top part of the rectangle. Below these larger motifs is a horizontal band of smaller, densely packed yellow floral or leafy patterns forming a border near the bottom edge. Both textile samples are set against an off-white or light beige paper background.
title: Handkerchief
